content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第9章这是什么家庭！
（..）小毛哥和冉冉前后脚走进来的时候，周望正坐在沙发上欣赏着手腕上的表。
他以前没有戴过表，但却在戴上这块表的第一时间就爱上了这种感觉，这一刻他竟然觉得这块表40万一点都不贵，甚至跟系统给他的底气都没有关系。
就一个字，真他妈的帅啊！
此时，正好冉冉和小毛哥走了过来，周望就向着冉冉展示了一下，问道：“你觉得怎么样？”
“挺好看的呀，很适合哥哥呢！”
冉冉很认真的打量了一下，点头说道。
她是真心觉得好看，而且周望此时穿的是范思哲刚买的那套休闲装，无论是色系还是风格，和这块腕表都莫名的搭。
“那就是它了！”
周望本来就有了决定，而冉冉并不知道这块表的价格，她既然也觉得不错，那这块手表应该能获得不错的“印象分”
在周望向冉冉展示的时候，小毛哥也下意识的看了一眼。
嗯，确实挺好看的，但并不是他熟悉的那几款万国的手表，小毛哥也不在意，他走上前笑道：“你好，我是冉冉的老板，有个事……”
“麻烦你等会儿！”
周望此时哪有心思听一个陌生人扯淡，毕竟回合时间已经所剩不多，他也不想再耽搁了，免得又出什么意外。
被周望直接打断了说话，小毛哥皱了皱眉，但还是忍住了。
“这块表我要了，在哪付款？”
周望看向了一直安静等待的曹经理。
出于专业素养，曹经理倒是没有表现出什么异样，只是心中还是有些惊讶于周望的爽快。
要知道从周望踏入店门到现在，满打满算都没超过十分钟啊……
在周望之前来看的那個客户明显也很喜欢这块表，但毕竟是40万的东西，所以没能第一时间下定决心，曹经理原本也没有指望能顺利卖出这块表。

“周先生，虽然您决定了，但我觉得还是有必要再跟您说明一个事实。”
“你说。”
见曹经理说的郑重，周望也就耐心的听着。
“我们IWC万国，其实针对不少热门表款都推出了不同的活动，简而言之，您购买我们大部分表款都是可以得到力度不等的折扣优惠的，而40万价位的手表，您也还有几款可以选择，比如飞行员系列的IW503604、葡萄牙系列的IW503406等等。”
曹经理语气恳切的说道，“在这些选择之中您未必不能找到心仪的款式，但如果您决定购买手上的这一款，因为是限量的关系，那您将得不到任何优惠，只能以436000的公价购买，所以……”
“噗……咳咳！”
在曹经理提醒周望的时候，拿起桌上的茶壶自顾自的倒了一杯水的小毛哥，却是被呛到了。
他惊愕的看了过去，一时间也不知道是在看周望还是在看他手上的那块表。
夺少？！
你们刚刚是说夺少……
他怀疑自己是不是听错了。
这块表……要泥马的40多万？
小毛哥其实不是那种沉不住气的人，但这一刻面目还是难以控制的有些扭曲。
曹经理的话被他的咳嗽打断，周望顿时皱眉看了他一眼，小毛哥下意识就做了一个告罪的手势。
与小毛哥相比，冉冉虽然也觉得一块表40多万很夸张，但她已经见识过周望在奢侈品店消费的痛快劲，所以倒没有太大的惊讶，反而有种理所当然的感觉。
不过虽然曹经理的话没有说完，但周望已经明白了他的意思。
那就是周望如果买其他同等价位的表，很可能会得到折扣，但这块表就必须用原价购买，有点“吃亏”
这个曹经理倒是很会为顾客考虑，这样的购物体验还有什么可挑剔的？

(..) When Brother Xiao Mao and Ran Ran walked in, Zhou Wang was sitting on the sofa admiring the watch on his wrist.
He had never worn a watch before, but he fell in love with the feeling the first time he put it on. At this moment, he felt that the 400,000 yuan watch was not expensive at all, and it had nothing to do with the confidence given to him by the system.
Just one word, so damn handsome!
At this time, Ran Ran and Brother Xiao Mao came over. Zhou Wang showed it to Ran Ran and asked, "What do you think?"
"It's very pretty. It suits my brother very well!"
Ran Ran looked at it carefully, nodded and said.
She really thought it looked good, and Zhou Wang was wearing the casual outfit he just bought from Versace. Both the color and style matched the watch inexplicably.
"That's it!"
Zhou Wang had already made his decision, but Ran Ran didn’t know the price of the watch. Since she thought it was good, the watch should get good “impression points”
When Zhou Wang showed it to Ran Ran, Brother Xiao Mao also glanced at it subconsciously.
Well, it's indeed pretty, but it's not the IWC watches he's familiar with. Brother Xiaomao didn't care. He walked up and said with a smile, "Hello, I'm Ranran's boss. I have something to do..."
"Please wait a moment!"
Zhou Wang didn't want to listen to a stranger's nonsense at this time. After all, there was not much time left in the round, and he didn't want to delay any more to avoid another accident.
Brother Xiaomao frowned when Zhou Wang interrupted him, but he still held it back.
"I want this watch. Where can I pay for it?"
Zhou Wang looked at Manager Cao, who had been waiting quietly.
Out of professionalism, Manager Cao didn't show anything strange, but he was still a little surprised at Zhou Wang's cheerfulness.
You know, from the time Zhou Wang stepped into the store until now, it has not taken more than ten minutes...
The customer who came to see it before Zhou Wang obviously liked the watch, but after all, it cost 400,000 yuan, so he couldn't make up his mind immediately. Manager Cao didn't expect to sell the watch smoothly.
"Mr. Zhou, although you have decided, I still think it is necessary to explain one more fact to you."
"You said."
Seeing that Manager Cao spoke solemnly, Zhou Wang listened patiently.
"We at IWC have actually launched different activities for many popular watches. In short, you can get discounts of varying degrees when purchasing most of our watches. For watches with a price of 400,000, you also have several models to choose from, such as the IW503604 of the pilot series, the IW503406 of the Portuguese series, etc."
Manager Cao said in a sincere tone, "You may not be able to find the style you like among these choices, but if you decide to buy this one, because it is limited, you will not get any discount and can only buy it at the public price of 436,000, so..."
"Pfft...ahem!"
When Manager Cao reminded Zhou Wang, Brother Xiao Mao picked up the teapot on the table and poured a glass of water on his own, but he choked.
He looked over in shock, not knowing for a moment whether he was looking at Zhou Wang or the watch in his hand.
Take less? !
You just said that you would seize the young master...
He wondered if he had heard wrongly.
This watch... costs more than 400,000 yuan?
Brother Xiaomao is actually not the kind of person who can't hold his temper, but at this moment, his face is still uncontrollably distorted.
Manager Cao's words were interrupted by his cough. Zhou Wang frowned and glanced at him, and Brother Xiao Mao subconsciously made an apologetic gesture.
Compared with Brother Xiaomao, although Ran Ran also thinks that a watch costing more than 400,000 yuan is exaggerated, she has already seen how happy Zhou Wang is to spend money in luxury stores, so it is not too big.Instead of being surprised, it felt like it was natural.
But although Manager Cao didn't finish what he said, Zhou Wang already understood what he meant.
That is, if Zhou Wang buys other watches of the same price, he is likely to get a discount, but this watch must be purchased at the original price, which is a bit of a "loss"
Manager Cao is very considerate of his customers. What else is there to say about this shopping experience?
